proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitRecord + passive mechanics family
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord has no 'species_trait' kind. types.ts defines UnitRecord = SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord — species traits are wholly absent. Darkvision is also always-on with no activation, no resource, no reset; no existing mechanics family can represent a permanent passive grant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_sense effect variant in surface types
proposed_widenings.justification: v4 taxonomy lists 'grant_sense' as an effect atom, but it appears in no effect union in types.ts (not ClassFeatureEffect, not MasteryEffect, not ReactionEffect). Darkvision is precisely a sense grant — the only honest atom is grant_sense with a range parameter.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

notes: Darkvision is a single-sentence always-on passive trait. No activation, no use count, no reset cadence. The surface has no SpeciesTraitRecord in UnitRecord and no passive mechanics family. Additionally grant_sense (a v4 atom) is absent from all effect unions in types.ts. All three gaps must be closed before this unit can be encoded honestly. Classification is structural_widening because the top-level kind is missing — the other two gaps are downstream consequences.
